mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but SPX 20-day returns are positive >60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by more than 2pp year-over-year, it signals a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y INDPRO growth slows by >2pp but SPX 60-day returns are positive >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 3%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 3% but SPX 20-day returns are positive >60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth accelerates by more than 20% year-over-year, it signals overexuberance in the housing market that will lead to a demand-driven slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y HOUST growth > 20% but SPX 60-day returns are positive >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 100k jobs per month for two consecutive months, it signals a labor market slowdown that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: M/M PAYEMS growth < -100k for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: M/M PAYEMS growth < -100k for 2 months but SPX 20-day returns are positive >60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real consumer spending growth slows by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Q/Q RSAFS growth < -2% but SPX 60-day returns are positive >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate rises above 3% and the federal funds rate is below 2%, it signals a high-inflation, low-rate environment that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2% but SPX 20-day returns are positive >60% of the time.
